novelty_flags.label: related_work and comparator_promise_table: LuoSunZhang2026BulkRecoverability
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal says Luo--Sun--Zhang restricts recoverability to linear aggregation with affine mechanisms, but its Theorem 4.3 assumes linear aggregation and its Corollaries 4.4--4.5 only derive affinity conditional on nondegenerate linear aggregation.

soundness_flags.label: def:certificate-procedure and thm:certificate-soundness-complexity
soundness_flags.one_line: Xi does not specify the recursive tail-majorant recurrence, interval-enclosure formulas, or deterministic choices that produce epsilon_tail and the certified bounds, so C(Xi) is not yet a mathematically determinate finite map with the claimed operation ceiling.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.3 begins by assuming that g is a linear aggregation; Corollaries 4.4--4.5 conclude that ANM/PNL mechanisms must be affine if functional-form consistency is preserved under a nondegenerate linear aggregation.

Definition 10 defines pairwise identifiability through positive-probability conditioning values and identifiable bivariate models; Lemma 11 states that a pairwise-identifiable CPCM DAG is identifiable from the joint distribution.
Under (A1)--(A3), the observational distribution uniquely determines the PT-SEM DAG, thinning coefficient matrix, and node-wise exogenous distributions.
The paper assumes spatial and temporal independence of link delays and proposes estimation of internal link delay cumulant generating functions from known-route end-to-end unicast measurements.
The paper treats finite and continuum moment conditions and states consistency and asymptotic normality of its estimator.
The article develops verification methods for mathematically rigorous results using floating-point arithmetic.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the certificate a literal deterministic algorithm: state the Poisson-tail recurrence and derivative/contrast majorants, interval Taylor remainder rule, terminal-box tests, and count every primitive operation used by the advertised bound.
Correct the Luo--Sun--Zhang comparison and add an explicit rank-frontier comparison against Chen--Cao--Bu that isolates the nonnegative-count/no-shift feature and the positive nullspace converse.

Add one non-synthetic, pilot-calibrated composition/box instance or formally state the benchmark strictly as a numerical-method testbed, separating methodological field relevance from biological claims.

recommended_next_step: Revise the certificate definition into a determinate finite procedure and repair the Luo--Sun--Zhang characterization; the remaining joint-certification kernel is field-level novel on the checked repo and published axes.
